events.description: A man fires a handgun; a bright muzzle flash is visible at the barrel, confirming discharge.
A man (Will Smith) fires a handgun; a bright muzzle flash is visible at frame f6, and the gun is clearly aimed and discharged in frames f5–f6.
A large, sudden explosion occurs on the bridge, engulfing the area in fire and smoke; visible as intense white/yellow flash at f9, rapidly expanding fireball at f10–f12.
A large, bright explosion erupts near construction barrels and a car, producing intense white flash and expanding fireball with smoke.

A classic muscle car is engulfed in flames and appears to be involved in a high-impact incident; it remains stationary or slowly moves through the fire zone amid debris and barrels, consistent with post-collision fire and damage.
A man (Will Smith) is shown aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash is visible at frame f5, and recoil/face reaction at f6 confirms discharge.
A massive, sudden fireball erupts from the ground near a classic muscle car, engulfing the vehicle in flames and smoke; the initial blast is extremely bright and expands rapidly.

A classic muscle car (likely a 1967–1969 Chevrolet Camaro) is involved in a high-impact incident, evidenced by its stationary position amid an explosion and subsequent fire; the car appears damaged and immobile after the blast.
Two metal barrels erupt in a sudden, intense fireball with rapid expansion of flames and smoke, consistent with a deflagration or explosion.

A vehicle (likely a truck or bus) is shown stationary but heavily involved in a hazardous scene with smoke and barrels; subsequent frames show fire engulfing a car, suggesting a collision or impact preceded the fire. The low-angle shot at f6–f7 shows the vehicle’s rear near hazard barrels, and by f8 the car is on fire—indicating a crash event occurred between f7 and f8.
A large, sudden fireball erupts from a vehicle or object on the road, producing a massive plume of smoke and flame that expands rapidly over several seconds.
A vehicle is engulfed in flames with visible structural damage; occupants are inside during initial fire outbreak, suggesting a crash preceded the fire.
A large, sudden fireball erupts from a vehicle or object on the road, producing a rapidly expanding plume of smoke and flame, characteristic of an explosion.
Initial impact or ignition event involving a vehicle (partially visible behind smoke in f1), preceding the full explosion; consistent with a crash that triggers fire/explosion.

Sustained, massive fireball engulfing a vehicle, with turbulent flame dynamics indicating ongoing explosive combustion (e.g., fuel tank rupture). The fire intensifies and fully consumes the vehicle structure.
